name: MTDC Holiday Resort Ajanta (Fardapur)
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's resort at Fardapur 4 km from the Ajanta Caves entrance — A/C and non-A/C cottages, in-house restaurant, the only formal accommodation at the cave gate. Books out for school-tour season (Nov–Feb).

name: Hotel Ajanta Heritage Jalgaon
location: Mahabal Road, Jalgaon (60 km from Ajanta)
why_special: Senior Jalgaon mid-range 3-star — multi-cuisine restaurant, 90-min drive to Ajanta T-Point. The Jalgaon-side base for travellers approaching Ajanta from the Bhusaval rail head, faster than the 100-km Aurangabad approach.

name: Radisson Blu Resort & Spa Alibaug
why_special: Radisson's 169-room beach resort 4 km from Alibaug town on Awas beach — large free-form pool, full-service spa, kids' club. The default chain-5-star Alibaug stay for Mumbai weekend families that want pool over heritage.

name: U Tropicana Alibaug
why_special: U Hotels' 47-cottage resort across landscaped grounds with one of the longest pools in Alibaug — full spa, kids' club, multi-cuisine restaurant. The Mumbai weekend-resort default with the most consistent reviews on Tripadvisor.

name: Fariyas Resort Alibaug
why_special: Fariyas Group resort on Varsoli beach — direct beach access, outdoor pool, the closest 4-star to Alibaug fort. The historical pick for the Alibaug weekend before the chain 5-stars arrived; still the strongest beach-walkout.

name: Acron Waterfront Resort Alibaug
why_special: Goa-based Acron Group's Alibaug resort with infinity pool overlooking the Arabian Sea — 60 rooms, multi-cuisine restaurant, the boutique mid-range pick between the Radisson 5-star and value beach homestays.

name: MTDC Resort Amboli
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's hill resort at Amboli ghat — A/C cottages with valley views over the Sahyadris, in-house restaurant. The default monsoon-tourism (Jun–Sep) and Hiranyakeshi Falls base.

name: Whistling Woods Resort Amboli
why_special: Private mid-range resort at Amboli ghat — cottage rooms with Sahyadri views, multi-cuisine restaurant. The polished alternative to MTDC for monsoon waterfall hunters.

name: Vivanta Aurangabad
why_special: Taj-IHCL's 4-star Vivanta near Bibi Ka Maqbara — 113 rooms, outdoor pool, Latitude all-day diner and Mynt for fine dining. The Aurangabad city hotel with the strongest Taj-group service and the easiest morning departure for the Ajanta/Ellora circuit.

name: WelcomHotel by ITC Rama International
why_special: ITC's WelcomHotel Rama International on Jalna Road — 134 rooms across landscaped grounds 3 km from Chikalthana airport, outdoor pool, the Pavilion all-day buffet, and the longest-running 5-star service brand in Aurangabad city.

name: Lemon Tree Premier Aurangabad
why_special: Lemon Tree Premier-tier with citrus-design rooms 4 km from Aurangabad airport — pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the most consistent mid-range brand service at 30–40% less than ITC Rama. The cleanest Ajanta/Ellora day-trip base on a budget.

name: The Meadows Hotel & Resort
why_special: 37-cottage resort across landscaped grounds on Mitmita Road, 5 km from Aurangabad railway and 8 km from Bibi-Ka-Maqbara — outdoor pool, on-site Maharashtrian restaurant, on-call taxi for the Ajanta-Ellora-Daulatabad triangle. The cottage-format pick when you want garden-grounds over a city block.

name: MTDC Resort Bhandardara
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's lakeside resort across landscaped grounds opposite the Wilson Dam — A/C cottages and Konkan tents, in-house restaurant, the only formal accommodation with direct Arthur Lake views.

name: Anandvan Resort Bhandardara
why_special: Private 28-room resort across landscaped grounds 2 km from Wilson Dam — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the polished mid-range alternative to MTDC. The base for Kalsubai Peak (Maharashtra's highest at 1,646 m) and Ratangad trekkers.

name: MTDC Bhimashankar Resort
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's hill resort within the Bhimashankar Wildlife Sanctuary buffer — A/C cottages with Sahyadri ridge views, in-house restaurant, the only formal accommodation near the Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga temple at the sanctuary edge.

name: Hotel Kailas
why_special: Senior budget-mid hotel directly opposite the Kailasa Temple cave entrance — 30 cottage-style rooms across landscaped grounds, multi-cuisine restaurant. The only accommodation walking-distance to the caves.

name: MTDC Ellora Resort
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's smaller Ellora property — basic A/C and non-A/C cottages, in-house restaurant, the value-rate alternative to Hotel Kailas at the cave gate.

name: MTDC Resort Ganpatipule
location: Ganpatipule Beach, opposite Swayambhu Ganpati Temple
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's flagship beach resort directly opposite the Swayambhu Ganpati temple — 100+ rooms in Konkani-style cottages plus tented Konkan tents, the only true beach-walkout property in Ganpatipule. Books out for Ganesh Chaturthi 6 months ahead.

name: Atithi Parinay Konkan Homestay
why_special: Award-winning Konkani homestay run by the Atithi Parinay family — traditional Konkan farmhouse with surangya floor and laterite walls, signature alu-vadi/sol-kadhi Maharashtrian thali. The benchmark Konkan-coast homestay; on the Maharashtra Tourism registered list.

name: Abhishek Beach Resort & Spa
why_special: Beach-front resort 500 m from the Swayambhu Ganpati temple — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant with Konkani thali, the private-resort alternative to MTDC when their cottages are full.

name: MTDC Harihareshwar Beach Resort
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's beach resort at Harihareshwar — 50 cottage rooms across landscaped grounds opposite the Kalbhairav temple, in-house restaurant, the only formal accommodation steps from the four-temple parikrama route.

name: Manas Lifestyle Resort Igatpuri
why_special: Mid-luxury wellness resort across 12 acres in the Sahyadri foothills — 76 rooms, full-service Ayurveda spa, indoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant. The Igatpuri destination wellness resort that pairs naturally with Dhamma Giri Vipassana meditation visitors.

name: The Fern Igatpuri
why_special: Fern Hotels' eco-certified Igatpuri resort with 56 rooms — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the polished mid-range brand pick. Closer to the Mumbai-Agra highway exit than Manas.

name: MTDC Karla Resort
location: Karla Caves area, near Ekvira Temple
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's hill resort 3 km from the Karla Caves entrance — A/C cottages, in-house restaurant, the closest formal accommodation to the Ekvira Devi Temple at the cave base. The pilgrim/cave-visitor default.

name: Prakruti Resort Kashid
why_special: Senior beach-front resort 200 m from Kashid beach — 40 cottage rooms across landscaped grounds, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant with Konkani thali. The longest-running Kashid resort and the consistent Mumbai weekend pick.

name: Kashid Beach Resort by RDB Hospitality
why_special: Direct beach-walkout resort with 35 rooms — outdoor pool, beach barbecue, multi-cuisine Konkani restaurant. The newer alternative to Prakruti with the strongest direct-beach access in Kashid.

name: Dukes Retreat
why_special: 1947 hill retreat across 7.5 acres above the Khandala ghats — heritage-style colonial main building, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine Mirage and Olive Garden restaurants. Khandala's longest-running named property and the Tungarli-side ridge alternative to Lonavala resorts.

name: Zara's Resort
why_special: Mid-range resort on the Old Mumbai-Pune Highway 1.5 km from Khandala station — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the value chain pick for Khandala-side weekend trips when Dukes is full.

name: Foliage Outdoors Kolad
why_special: Adventure-tourism camp by the Kundalika river — A/C and non-A/C luxury tents, river-rafting operator with rapids Class II–III on the dam-release schedule. The Kolad-rafting weekend base for Mumbai/Pune groups.

name: Kundalika Riverside Resort
why_special: Private mid-range resort on the Kundalika river bank — 25 cottages, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant. The polished alternative to tent camps for families that want rafting access without sleeping under canvas.

name: Hotel Sayaji Kolhapur
why_special: Sayaji Hotels' 5-star Kolhapur flagship 5 km from city centre — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine Kebabsta and Habibi (Lebanese). The polished 5-star anchor for Mahalaxmi Temple pilgrim families and Panhala Fort visitors, with the strongest spa in town.

name: Hotel Pearl Kolhapur
location: Sykes Extension, near New Mahadwar Road
why_special: Kolhapur's senior 3-star walking-distance from Mahalaxmi Temple — 60 rooms, Maharashtrian/non-veg restaurant Mahabhog, the local pick for pilgrim families that want temple-proximity over highway 5-stars.

name: Hotel Tulsi Kolhapur
why_special: Mid-range 3-star opposite Kolhapur railway station — 56 rooms, vegetarian restaurant, the reliable pick for overnight train arrivals continuing to Panhala or Jyotiba. Walking-distance to Mahalaxmi Temple (1.5 km).

name: Shree Lenyadri Ganpati Devasthan Trust Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The temple-trust accommodation directly below the Lenyadri Ganpati cave (one of Astavinayak's eight) — basic dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. The official pilgrim-only bed, bookable through the Junnar Devasthan office.

name: MTDC Resort Lonar
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's resort on the rim of India's only meteor-impact saline crater lake — basic A/C cottages, in-house restaurant, the closest formal accommodation to the lake rim walk. The default and effectively only choice for Lonar overnight.

name: Della Resorts Lonavala
why_special: India's largest adventure-led resort across 90 acres in Tungarli — over 60 adventure activities including a Sky Bar at 65 ft, Zorbing, and the country's only suspended fine-dining restaurant. The Lonavala destination resort for weekend Mumbai/Pune families.

name: Fariyas Resort Lonavala
why_special: Fariyas Group's flagship Tungarli hill resort with one of Lonavala's longest pools — indoor games, multi-cuisine restaurant. The senior 4-star pick before Della arrived; still the better choice when adventure isn't the agenda.

name: Rhythm Lonavala
why_special: All-suite boutique resort with one-bedroom and family suites — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the Lonavala all-suite pick on the Pawna lake side. Better-sized rooms than Fariyas at similar pricing.

name: Hilton Shillim Estate Retreat & Spa
why_special: Hilton-managed 320-acre wellness retreat in the Shillim Valley 45 min from Lonavala — Ayurveda spa across 12,000 sq m, 100+ rooms in heritage cottages, the South-Asian destination wellness resort. The Lonavala-adjacent splurge when wellness beats adventure.

name: Le Méridien Mahabaleshwar Resort & Spa
why_special: Marriott's Le Méridien — Mahabaleshwar's only branded 5-star with 121 rooms across the ridge, indoor heated pool, full-service spa, the Latitude all-day diner. The hill-station 5-star default with the strongest reviews on Tripadvisor.

name: Brightland Resort & Spa
location: Khadi Ghat, near Mahabaleshwar bus stand
why_special: Brightland Group's flagship resort across 23 acres on the Khadi Ghat ridge — heated pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, Mahabaleshwar's longest-running mid-tier resort brand. The reliable 4-star bridge between MTDC and the Le Méridien.

name: Evershine Resort, Spa & Wellness
why_special: Evershine's 7-acre Old-Mahabaleshwar resort with heated pool and full-service ayurveda spa — strawberry-farm walks on-property (Mahabaleshwar's signature crop) and the closest mid-tier resort to the Panchganga temple.

name: Hotel PG Regency Mahad
why_special: Mid-range business hotel on the Mumbai-Goa highway near Mahad — multi-cuisine restaurant, the reliable mid-tier overnight for travellers en route to Raigad fort or Konkan coast.

name: Sai Vishram Beach Resort
why_special: Beach-front resort on Chivla beach — 30 rooms, outdoor pool, Malvani thali restaurant. The senior private-resort pick in Malvan town with the strongest beach-walkout to Sindhudurg fort viewpoint.

name: Malvan Beach Resort (MTDC)
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's smaller Malvan property — basic A/C and non-A/C rooms steps from the boat jetty to Sindhudurg fort. The official-rate pilgrim/fort-visitor pick, smaller than Tarkarli sister property.

name: Verandah in the Forest (Dune Barr House)
why_special: 1853 Captain Barr colonial bungalow restored by Neemrana — 11 rooms with original wood floors and verandahs over the Matheran forest. India's earliest hill-station bungalow turned hotel; the only true heritage stay on India's smallest hill station.

name: Lord's Central Hotel
why_special: 1933 Parsi family-run hotel on Matheran's MG Road — vegetarian, no-alcohol, classic colonial wraparound verandahs, the same Lord family running the property for four generations. The senior heritage Parsi hotel in Matheran.

name: Usha Ascot Matheran
why_special: Pure-vegetarian 4-star resort with rope-style cottages across landscaped grounds — outdoor pool (rare for Matheran), multi-cuisine veg restaurant, the modern resort alternative to the Lord's/Verandah heritage axis.

name: Shri Mayureshwar Bhakta Niwas (Chinchwad Devasthan Trust)
why_special: The Chinchwad Devasthan Trust's official pilgrim accommodation for Morgaon's Mayureshwar Ganpati (first temple of the Astavinayak yatra) — dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. Book through Chinchwad Devasthan office.

name: The Taj Mahal Palace, Mumbai
why_special: 1903 sea-facing heritage palace facing the Gateway of India — twin-wing property (Palace 1903 + Tower 1973), 285 rooms across 11 acres, the most-photographed hotel in India. Sea Lounge afternoon-tea ritual and Harbour Bar (Mumbai's oldest licensed bar, 1933) anchor the experience.

name: The Oberoi Mumbai
why_special: Nariman Point tower with Arabian Sea views from every sea-facing room and the Queen's Necklace Marine Drive sweep below. 287 rooms, Ziya (Vineet Bhatia's Michelin-starred Indian) on the lobby level, calmer counterpoint to the Taj's Gateway bustle.

name: Trident Nariman Point
why_special: Sister-property to The Oberoi in the same Nariman Point seafront complex — same Arabian Sea views at roughly 40% less than the Oberoi tower. India Jones (pan-Asian) and Frangipani run the dining. Best value sea-view 5-star in South Mumbai.

name: Four Seasons Hotel Mumbai
why_special: 33-floor glass tower in Worli with Aer rooftop bar on level 34 — Mumbai's most-photographed skyline view. 202 rooms central to the new luxury axis of BKC/Lower Parel. Pick this if your Mumbai trip leans nightlife, fashion week, or business over Gateway tourism.

name: Abode Bombay
why_special: 20-room boutique inside a restored 1910 colonial house above Colaba Causeway — design-led, art-deco-furniture, walk to Gateway/Taj/Leopold Cafe. Mumbai's first true boutique hotel and still the most distinctive small property in South Mumbai.

name: Zostel Mumbai
why_special: India's flagship backpacker chain in Andheri West — dorms ₹600–1,200, private rooms ₹1,800+. 15 min to BOM airport, walking-distance to Andheri station for South-Mumbai trips by Metro Line 1. The most reliable budget social bed in the city.

name: Golden Swan Beach Resort
why_special: Senior beach-front resort 100 m from Murud beach — 50 cottage rooms across landscaped grounds, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant with Konkani fish-thali. The default Murud-Janjira fort-visitor base since 1990s.

name: Sea Shell Resort Murud
why_special: Mid-range beach resort with 30 rooms — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the value-tier pick at Murud. Walking-distance to Janjira fort boat jetty at low tide.

name: Radisson Blu Hotel Nagpur
why_special: 5-star on Wardha Road with the strongest cleanliness and service reviews in Nagpur — central for both Dr Ambedkar Airport (10 min) and city sightseeing. Outdoor pool, gym, breakfast spread widely cited. The default Nagpur pick for travellers heading on to Tadoba.

name: Le Méridien Nagpur
why_special: Marriott-Bonvoy 5-star with spacious rooms and an expansive lawn — strong for business-conference groups. 7 km from Nagpur airport. Spa, gym, La Brasserie all-day diner. The Marriott loyalty member's pick over the Radisson.

name: The Pride Hotel Nagpur
why_special: Pride Group 4-star directly opposite Nagpur airport — friendly mid-range service at 40–50% the Radisson Blu rate. The Nagpur pick when you need a clean comfortable business hotel without the 5-star markup, particularly for early Tadoba departures.

name: Tuli Imperial Nagpur
why_special: Local Tuli Group 4-star in Ramdaspeth — central for old Nagpur sightseeing (Deekshabhoomi, Zero Mile Marker) rather than the airport hotels. Multi-cuisine restaurant Tuli Imperial, popular with Marathi business travellers, the home-grown alternative to chain options.

name: The Source at Sula
why_special: Sula's own 32-room luxury wing inside the working vineyard — vine-view rooms, on-property tasting rooms and 1-2-1 wine experiences with the winemaking team. The destination property for Nashik wine tourism; rates spike sharply during SulaFest in February.

name: Beyond by Sula
why_special: Sula's value-tier sister to The Source — comfort rooms with vineyard outlooks at roughly 40% less. Same Sula tasting access, same vine-walk before breakfast, smaller pool. The wine-country pick when you want vineyard access without Source pricing.

name: Regenta Resort Soma Vine Village
why_special: Royal Orchid's Regenta resort attached to Soma Vineyards — 4 outdoor pools, full-service spa, walk-the-vines on the property's own working winery. 10-min drive from Sula. The destination pool/spa resort for wine tourism that isn't trying to be Sula.

name: Express Inn Nashik
why_special: Central Nashik 5-star on the Mumbai-Agra highway, 10 km from Sula — full business facilities, rooftop pool, multi-cuisine dining. Best for Trimbakeshwar pilgrims and visitors combining wine tourism with Panchavati ghats and Kalaram temple.

name: ibis Nashik Hotel
why_special: Accor-brand ibis 5 km from Sula — modern eco-certified rooms, the most reliable mid-tier brand in Nashik. Use as a base, day-trip to Sula via hotel cab (20 min). Sister property ibis Styles next door for slightly higher tier.

name: Shri Vighneshwar Ganpati Devasthan Trust Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The Devasthan Trust's official pilgrim accommodation at Ozar's Vighneshwar Ganpati (Astavinayak temple) — dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. The default Astavinayak pilgrim bed for Ozar.

name: Shri Ballaleshwar Ganpati Devasthan Trust Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The Devasthan Trust's official pilgrim accommodation at Pali's Ballaleshwar Ganpati (Astavinayak temple) — dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. The default Astavinayak pilgrim bed for Pali.

name: Ravine Hotel
why_special: Senior Panchgani 4-star with 50 rooms across landscaped grounds on the ridge — heated pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, mountain views toward Table Land. The local longest-running mid-tier in Panchgani; consistent reviews on Tripadvisor.

name: Citrus Chambers Mahabaleshwar (Panchgani road)
why_special: Citrus Hotels' 50-room resort midway between Panchgani and Mahabaleshwar — outdoor pool, mountain ridge views toward Krishna Valley. The pick when you want both hill stations in one base; closer to Panchgani's Table Land.

name: SaffronStays Verandah by the Valley
why_special: 5-bedroom SaffronStays villa on the valley edge of Khingar village — private pool, full kitchen, the Panchgani vacation-rental pick for groups of 8–12 over a resort. Books out months ahead for long weekends.

name: Baghvan Pench (Taj Safaris)
location: Awarghani Village, near Khursapar gate (MP side, shared border)
why_special: Taj Safaris flagship — 12 suites with private plunge pools, naturalist-led twice-daily safaris, full-board Indian and continental. The luxury Pench safari signature; bookable as Pench Maharashtra-side base since most Pench tigers cross the inter-state border.

name: Pench Jungle Camp
why_special: 30-cottage safari resort by Sillari gate (Pench Maharashtra) — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, naturalist-led twice-daily safaris. The senior mid-range Pench-Maharashtra base; runs since 2007 with consistent Tripadvisor reviews.

name: MTDC Pench Resort
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's value-rate Pench resort near Sillari gate — simple A/C cottages, safari-booking desk, the budget alternative to Pench Jungle Camp for self-driving Nagpur visitors.

name: JW Marriott Hotel Pune
why_special: 414 rooms on Senapati Bapat Road equidistant from Koregaon Park and Hinjawadi — 8 dining venues including Spice Kitchen (Indian) and Alto Vino (Italian). The Pune business 5-star with rooftop temperature-controlled pool and easiest cross-city positioning.

name: Conrad Pune
why_special: Hilton's Conrad on Mangaldas Road — closer to Aga Khan Palace / Shaniwar Wada heritage core than the IT-park hotels. Rooftop pool, Coriander Kitchen all-day buffet praised for breakfast spread variety. The default pick when your Pune trip mixes old-city sightseeing with business.

name: Hyatt Regency Pune
why_special: Large-format Hyatt on Weikfield IT Park 25 min from Pune airport (PNQ) — the airport-run hotel with strong conference facilities and reliable Hyatt service at roughly 25% less than JW Marriott. Best last-night-before-flight bed in Pune.

name: Marriott Suites Pune
why_special: All-suite Marriott in Koregaon Park — Pune's best neighbourhood for cafes, boutiques, and nightlife. Suites are notably larger than standard 5-star rooms, pet-friendly, 10-min walk to German Bakery and Osho Garden. The Pune pick for longer stays or families.

name: The O Hotel Pune
why_special: Boutique design hotel on North Main Road, Koregaon Park — rooftop pool with city view, Addis Ababa for African cuisine. The walk-out neighbourhood for cafes and nightlife minus the 5-star pricing.

name: Hotel Sunderban
why_special: 1932 Art Deco bungalow in Koregaon Park — 32 rooms across the original house and newer block, vegetarian Maharashtrian/Gujarati thali at Mango Tree restaurant, gardens used for Pune weddings. The closest thing to a heritage stay in Koregaon Park.

name: MTDC Raigad Resort
location: Pachad village, base of Raigad Fort
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's resort at Pachad village at the foot of the Raigad Fort ropeway — A/C cottages, in-house Maharashtrian restaurant, the closest formal accommodation to the fort climb that Chhatrapati Shivaji crowned himself at in 1674.

name: Shri Mahaganpati Devasthan Trust Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The Devasthan Trust's official pilgrim accommodation at Ranjangaon's Mahaganpati (Astavinayak temple) — dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. The default Astavinayak pilgrim bed for Ranjangaon.

name: Kohinoor Samudra Beach Resort
why_special: Kohinoor Group's beach resort 11 km south of Ratnagiri town on Ganeshgule beach — 70 cottage-style rooms across landscaped grounds, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine Konkani restaurant. The polished beach-resort default for Ratnagiri.

name: Hotel Landmark Ratnagiri
why_special: Senior Ratnagiri town 3-star at Maruti Mandir junction — multi-cuisine restaurant, the reliable mid-range pick for travellers using Ratnagiri as a Konkan-route overnight rather than a beach stay.

name: Pawas Swaroopanand Ashram Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The Swami Swaroopanand Pawas ashram's pilgrim accommodation 19 km south of Ratnagiri — simple twin and family rooms attached to the samadhi mandir, satvic meals included. Booking through ashram directly; the spiritual alternative to beach resorts.

name: Hotel Preet Resort Satara
why_special: Senior Satara highway-side resort on NH-48 — 50 rooms, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant. The reliable Satara base for Kaas Plateau (Sep–Oct flower bloom) and Thoseghar Falls day-trippers.

name: Hotel Yatra Inn Satara
why_special: Mid-range business hotel at Powai Naka junction — multi-cuisine vegetarian restaurant, walking distance to Ajinkyatara Fort base. The clean budget pick for Satara town stays.

name: Saibansi Bhakta Niwas (Shirdi Sansthan)
why_special: The official Sai Baba Sansthan Trust accommodation — 3,300+ rooms across Saibansi/New Bhakta Niwas/Sai Ashram complexes adjacent to the Samadhi Mandir. The default pilgrim bed at sansthan rates (₹150–₹2,500), bookable on the official online.sai.org.in portal.

name: Sun-n-Sand Shirdi
why_special: Sun-n-Sand Group's Shirdi 5-star 800 m from Samadhi Mandir — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine vegetarian restaurant Spice Garden, the polished pilgrim-hotel pick for families wanting 5-star service near the temple.

name: St. Laurn Suites Shirdi
why_special: St. Laurn Group's Shirdi 4-star with 100 suites 500 m from the Samadhi Mandir — outdoor pool, vegetarian multi-cuisine restaurant, the suite-pick for pilgrim families that want bigger rooms over a 5-star tag.

name: Shri Siddhivinayak Ganpati Devasthan Trust Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The Devasthan Trust's official pilgrim accommodation at Siddhatek's Siddhivinayak Ganpati (Astavinayak temple) — dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. Siddhatek is the most isolated Astavinayak temple (Karha river island), so the trust accommodation is effectively the only option.

name: Svasara Jungle Lodge
why_special: Mid-luxury jungle lodge with 12 villas adjacent to Kolara gate — naturalist-led safaris twice daily, full-board Maharashtrian/multi-cuisine. Tripadvisor #1 in Tadoba; the consistent pick when Taj Safaris feels excessive.

name: Bamboo Forest Safari Lodge
why_special: Across 18 acres adjacent to Moharli gate — 15 stilted cottages, naturalist-led twice-daily safaris, pool. The Moharli-gate alternative to Svasara/Irai; deepest forest setting of Tadoba's resorts.

name: Irai Safari Retreat
why_special: Mid-range safari resort 800 m from Kolara gate — 30 rooms across cottages and rooms, outdoor pool, naturalist-led twice-daily safaris. The value-tier Tadoba pick at ~40% the Svasara rate.

name: Tigers Heaven Resort
why_special: 12-cottage safari lodge near Moharli gate — naturalist-led safaris, multi-cuisine restaurant, pool. The cleaner mid-range pick at Moharli when Bamboo Forest is full.

name: MTDC Tarkarli Beach Resort
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's flagship Konkan beach resort — A/C cottages and Konkan tents on the white-sand Tarkarli beach, the only government-rate property with full beach walkout. Books out December–February (peak diving season) and Ganesh Chaturthi months in advance.

name: Konkan Wave Beach Resort
why_special: Private 4-star beach resort on the Tarkarli–Devbag stretch — 50 rooms, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine Malvani restaurant. The polished-resort alternative to MTDC when its A/C cottages are booked out.

name: Bhogwe Beach Homestays (Tarkarli/Devbag fisher-family circuit)
why_special: Cluster of MTDC-registered Konkani fisher-family homestays on Bhogwe beach 12 km from Tarkarli — Malvani fish-thali (surmai, prawns), boat rides to dolphins from family-owned boats. The authentic alternative when MTDC is full and resort food feels too clean.

name: Shri Chintamani Ganpati Devasthan Trust Bhakta Niwas
why_special: The Chinchwad Devasthan Trust's official pilgrim accommodation at Theur's Chintamani Ganpati (Astavinayak temple) — dormitory and family rooms at trust rates, vegetarian prasad meals. The default Astavinayak pilgrim bed for Theur.

name: MTDC Resort Trimbakeshwar
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's resort below the Brahmagiri hill, walking-distance from the Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga temple — A/C cottages, in-house vegetarian restaurant. The default Jyotirlinga pilgrim bed and Brahmagiri-Godavari source-trek base.
